$comment: Engine divergence register (specs/scheduler-unification.md §4 m1.s1, §6), checked by engine-divergence-register.test.ts.

Every place where engine A (the pixel layout) and engine C (scheduleRoadmap) give a sample's named item or wave a different span, keyed by sample path, then by item id, '<include path>#<id>' for an item of a first-level isolated region, or 'wave:<id>'.

classes lists every divergence of spec §1.2 that contributes, (b) to (f), or region-scope when the engines give an isolated region a different scope (§1.2, 'Isolated regions without waves'). Fixing a divergence removes its letter, and the entry once no letter is left. (a), the pixel walker starting an after: child at the lane's left edge instead of its cursor, was settled by F1 (specs/scheduler-unification.md §5), so no entry carries it. F2 and F3 settled (c), (d) and (e), and moved (b) out of the lane cursor: a (b) entry now marks only a bar drawn at its minimum width, which is presentation (§8 decision 6).
